false, "markdown": "## C2 — KG handoff hints — Rules of the Road
Scope: Sec 9 flex freeway express entry-exit meters interchanges intersections markings speed roundabout signals signs yield.

FACT_ID: C2-FLX1 | anchor: P49
group_hint: flex-lanes; prereq_hint: [lane-markings]; difficulty_hint: 2; weight: pedagogic_emphasis medium; confusable_with: [C2-MRK1]
Overhead lane-use indication controls whether a flex lane may be entered at that time. [P49]
Source: [P49 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: C2-FWY1 | anchor: P49
group_hint: freeway-conduct; prereq_hint: [following-distance]; difficulty_hint: 2; weight: pedagogic_emphasis high; confusable_with: [C2-INOUT1]
Freeway through travel keeps spacing, stays out of the emergency shoulder, and changes lanes only for passing or route needs. [P49]
Source: [P49 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: C2-EXP1 | anchor: P50
group_hint: express-lanes; prereq_hint: [lane-markings]; difficulty_hint: 3; weight: pedagogic_emphasis medium; confusable_with: [C2-FLX1, C2-MRK1]
Express-lane entry and exit happen only where dotted access striping permits, not across solid boundary lines. [P50]
Source: [P50 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: C2-INOUT1 | anchor: P50
group_hint: merge-exit; prereq_hint: [signaling]; difficulty_hint: 2; weight: pedagogic_emphasis high; confusable_with: [C2-FWY1]
Merging uses the acceleration space to match flow before joining, and exiting moves early then steadies before slowing. [P50]
Source: [P50 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: C2-RMP1 | anchor: P51
group_hint: ramp-control; prereq_hint: [signals]; difficulty_hint: 2; weight: pedagogic_emphasis low; confusable_with: [C2-SIG1]
Ramp-meter operation and runaway-ramp prohibition depend on posted activation and emergency-only use. [P51]
Source: [P51 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: C2-INT1 | anchor: P51
group_hint: intersection-procedure; prereq_hint: [right-of-way]; difficulty_hint: 2; weight: pedagogic_emphasis high; confusable_with: [C2-YLD1, C2-CFI1]
Intersection approach stop position and through movement keep lane discipline and lookout in all directions. [P51]
Source: [P51 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: C2-CFI1 | anchor: P52
group_hint: novel-intersections; prereq_hint: [intersection-procedure]; difficulty_hint: 3; weight: pedagogic_emphasis medium; confusable_with: [C2-INT1]
Continuous-flow, diverging-diamond, and thru-U-turn layouts reroute left movements and need signal-by-signal compliance. [P52]
Source: [P52 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0052]

FACT_ID: C2-MRK1 | anchor: P53
group_hint: pavement-markings; prereq_hint: [none]; difficulty_hint: 1; weight: pedagogic_emphasis high; confusable_with: [C2-FLX1, C2-EXP1]
Line color and pattern encode direction separation and whether passing or crossing is allowed. [P53]
Source: [P53 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0053]

FACT_ID: C2-SPD1 | anchor: P54
group_hint: speed-choice; prereq_hint: [basic-speed-law]; difficulty_hint: 2; weight: pedagogic_emphasis high; confusable_with: [C2-FWY1]
Posted context speeds give way to slower reasonable speed when hazards, road shape, or visibility demand it. [P54]
Source: [P54 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: C2-RBT1 | anchor: P55
group_hint: roundabouts; prereq_hint: [yielding]; difficulty_hint: 1; weight: pedagogic_emphasis medium; confusable_with: [C2-YLD1]
Roundabout entry slows, yields to circulating users and pedestrians, then exits at the wanted leg. [P55]
Source: [P55 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: C2-SIG1 | anchor: P55
group_hint: traffic-signals; prereq_hint: [none]; difficulty_hint: 2; weight: pedagogic_emphasis high; confusable_with: [C2-SGN1, C2-RMP1]
Steady versus flashing indications differ in stop, yield, and directional permission, including turn arrows. [P55]
Source: [P55 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: C2-SGN1 | anchor: P57
group_hint: traffic-signs; prereq_hint: [signal-meaning]; difficulty_hint: 2; weight: pedagogic_emphasis high; confusable_with: [C2-SIG1]
Regulatory warning guide work-zone and rail-crossing sign families differ by shape color and required response. [P57]
Source: [P57 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: C2-YLD1 | anchor: P60
group_hint: right-of-way; prereq_hint: [intersection-procedure]; difficulty_hint: 2; weight: pedagogic_emphasis high; confusable_with: [C2-INT1, C2-RBT1]
Yield priority goes to the party already present or with positional priority, never assumed by the learner. [P60]
